name: Landbot
task: Website or Shopify chat & FAQ deflection
summary: No-code chatbot builder for websites, WhatsApp and Messenger: design conversation flows visually or from a template, add AI agent blocks, and send the answers to your CRM or spreadsheet.
best_for: marketing, sales and support teams that want a visual, no-code chatbot for lead capture or first-line answers on their website or WhatsApp, and want to start free and pay a fixed monthly base with published overage prices
skip_if: you need an AI agent answering most conversations at high volume (the €0.10 AI-chat meter adds up), you need a full help desk with ticketing rather than a bot builder, or you need a written no-training guarantee for every AI feature
honest_knock: There are two meters, and the second one is easy to miss: every conversation that touches an AI block counts as an AI chat at €0.10 beyond the allowance, on top of regular chat overage sold in €25 packs. Starter keeps Landbot branding and has no own WhatsApp number, so most business use starts at Professional. The pages also disagree with each other: the pricing page says chats are not used to train models, while clause 10.9 of the terms describes anonymised training for four AI features through OpenAI; and the pricing page says your history is never deleted, while the billing FAQ deactivates inactive accounts after 6 months (downgraded) or 30 days (never paid).

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-25 on landbot.io/pricing with both the Annual and the Monthly toggle clicked, and in Landbot's billing FAQ at help.landbot.io) Free is €0 for 100 chats a month, one seat, the full builder and templates, and a WhatsApp test number, but no AI chats. Starter is €32 a month billed annually or €40 paid monthly, with 500 chats, 100 AI chats and 2 seats. Professional is €80 annually or €100 monthly, with 2,500 chats, 300 AI chats, 3 seats, no Landbot branding and the HubSpot, Airtable and webhook integrations. Professional WA, the WhatsApp tier, is €160 annually or €200 monthly with 500 AI chats. Business is priced by contract, from 5 seats, with one WhatsApp number, dedicated support and an uptime SLA. Over your allowance, each extra chat costs €0.05, billed in 500-chat packs of €25, and each extra AI chat €0.10; an extra seat is €25 a month. Prices are before tax, and annual billing is a 12-month commitment. There is a 14-day trial with everything included, after which the account drops to Free without a card.

compare_with.name: Tidio
compare_with.why: Tidio is in our dossiers and lives on ZeroTouchSupport: its Starter was 24.17 a month billed annually or 29 monthly when we read its pricing page on 24 August 2026, and it combines live chat, a help desk and the Lyro AI agent, each on its own meter. Landbot is the stronger pick when the job is designing a conversation flow (lead qualification, forms, WhatsApp journeys) in a visual builder; Tidio fits a team that wants a help desk with chat and AI answers in one inbox.
